sources.title: OLMo2 - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: OLMo2 improves on OLMo by changing the architecture and training recipes of the original models. This includes excluding all biases to improve training stability, non-parametric layer norm, SwiGLU activation function, rotary positional embeddings, and a modified BPE-based tokenizer that masks personal identifiable information. It is pretrained on Dolma, a dataset of 3T tokens.
